hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: We want permutations of 1..n such that for every 1-indexed position i, nums[i] % i == 0 or i % nums[i] == 0.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Since n <= 15, we can use bitmask dynamic programming or memoized depth-first search.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Let mask represent the set of used numbers. The current position being filled is popcount(mask) + 1. Transition by trying each available number satisfying the condition.
